1. (Currently amended) A belly pan for a motor vehicle, comprising: a body panel having a forward section constructed from an open rib structure __and a plurality of closed ribs flanking said open rib structure__; and an aero cover carried on said body panel and spanning said open rib structure.

2. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 1, wherein said body panel includes a first forward corner and a second forward corner, __each corner including a buttress structure__.

3. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 2, wherein said first forward corner includes a first section of open rib structure and said second forward corner includes a second section of open rib structure, __said open rib structures being integral with and reinforcing said buttress structures__.

4. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 3, including a first aero cover spanning and closing said first section of open rib structure and a second aero cover spanning and closing said second section of open rib structure, __wherein said aero covers are removably secured to said body panel__.

5. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 4, wherein said first section of open rib structure includes a first fore-aft rib and a first plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said first fore-aft rib, __said transverse ribs being spaced at regular intervals along said fore-aft rib__.

6. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 5, wherein said second section of open rib structure includes a second fore-aft rib and a second plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said second fore-aft rib, __said second transverse ribs being spaced at regular intervals along said second fore-aft rib__.

7. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 6, wherein said body panel includes a plurality of closed ribs, said first section of open rib structure being provided between a first two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs and said second section of open rib structure being provided between a second two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs, __said closed ribs extending continuously across the width of said body panel__.

8. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 7, including fasteners securing said first aero cover and said second aero cover to said body panel, __said fasteners being positioned to avoid interference with said open rib structures__.

9. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 8, wherein said body panel includes a first corner buttress and a second corner buttress, __said buttresses being load-bearing structural elements__.

10. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 9, wherein said first section of open rib structure forms a part of said first buttress and said second section of open rib structure forms a part of said second buttress, __said open rib structures providing reinforcement to said buttresses while maintaining a reduced weight profile__.

11. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 10, wherein said body panel is made from a material having a tensile and flexural modulus of at least 7.8 GPa __and is specifically formulated to provide enhanced structural rigidity while maintaining impact resistance__.

12. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 11, wherein said body panel is molded from polypropylene reinforced with 40% long glass fibers __using an injection molding process that ensures uniform fiber distribution__.

13. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 12, wherein said body panel has a thickness of about 3.5 mm __and said thickness is selected to optimize the balance between structural strength and weight reduction__.

14. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 13, wherein said first aero cover and said second aero cover have a thickness of about 2.5 mm __and are configured to conform precisely to the contours of said open rib structures__.

15. (Currently amended) A belly pan for a motor vehicle, comprising: a body panel having a first corner buttress, a second corner buttress, a first open rib structure reinforcing said first corner buttress and a second open rib structure reinforcing said second corner buttress, __wherein said body panel further includes a plurality of closed ribs flanking said open rib structures__; a first aero cover spanning and closing said first open rib structure; and a second aero cover spanning and closing said second open rib structure.

16. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 15, wherein said body panel includes a first section and a second section secured together by fasteners, __said sections being configured to allow independent molding and assembly__.

17. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 16, wherein said first corner buttress is on said first section and said second corner buttress is on said second section, __said buttresses being positioned at the forward corners of said body panel__.

18. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 17, wherein said first open rib structure includes a first fore-aft rib and a first plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said first fore-aft rib, __said ribs being configured to distribute structural loads__.

19. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 18, wherein said second open rib structure includes a second fore-aft rib and a second plurality of transverse ribs projecting from opposed sides of said second fore-aft rib, __said second ribs being configured to distribute structural loads__.

20. (Currently amended) The belly pan of claim 19, wherein said body panel includes a plurality of closed ribs, said first section of open rib structure being provided between a first two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs and said second section of open rib structure being provided between a second two ribs of said plurality of closed ribs, __said closed ribs providing continuous structural support across said body panel__.
